methods.description: Substitute known factors into a product formula and divide by the nonzero coefficient.
Substitute then undo addition/subtraction and multiplication in reverse order.
Substitute into speed/reciprocal formula, multiply both sides by a nonzero unknown denominator, then divide.
Substitute known outside factors, divide first, then undo the operation inside brackets.
Substitute into a grouped fractional formula and solve using its full numerator.
Identify quantities from supplied geometric formulas/relations and solve the resulting linear equation with units.
Use a contextual cost or temperature formula, substitute known values and solve for the required quantity.
Keep the exact time fraction while converting remaining hours to minutes, rounding only at the end when required.
